rule: Actual gathered FP16 inputs only, each matched to its own original BF16 expert. Same singleW4/S4x2 fused chain and production IQ2/Q2/XMX baseline as frozen chain experiment. 24 physical copies of the matching expert, separate pinned-host copies. Per-call pack and full H2D included. Serial in-order queue, one wait per8. Warm8 then8 ABBA cycles,24 calls/arm. Each arm drift<=3%,>=6of8stable and median gain>=10%,screen+independentconfirm. Full finite GU/Y error no worse than native in each actual input; original BF16 rounded to FP16 reference. No full-model speed or quality claim.

capture.rule: Busiest expert in each of layers0/24/47, deterministic lowest-ID tie, Code2K and Prose2K. Export all512 route counts at each capture, total must equal T*K. Original IQ2/Q2 compute and existing phase synchronization; full frozen baseline outputs required. These are selected hot examples, not representative of the whole model. Official BF16 weights must be fetched for these exact IDs before W4 replay. No speed evidence from capture. Short16 then Code2K128/Prose2K128; full frozen baseline outputs required. No model or operator speed claim.

conversion.rule: Only the busiest actual routed experts in layers0/24/47 for the two valid captured prompts. Original BF16 slices via pinned HTTPS + verified HTTP206/Content-Range. Local slice SHA256 is recorded, not a remote checksum proof. Direct single U4 group64 FP32 scales; current IQ2/Q2 used only as baseline/layout check, never as U4 input. Selected hot samples are not representative model quality or speed.

original_capture_failure.rule: Only export real gathered FP16 input rows for layer0/expert0,24/255,47/511, matching original BF16 samples. Same corrected-GDN objects and original IQ2/Q2 compute; no quantized replacement. Fail on nonfinite inputs or existing outputs. Fresh output directory per process. Capture adds waits and disk IO: diagnostic/quality input only, no timing acceptance. Short16 then Code2K128/Prose2K128; full frozen baseline outputs required. No model or operator speed claim.

synchronized_sparse_capture.rule: First capture retained as baseline full-output failure. Same frozen original-IQ2/Q2 capture EXE, enable existing PREFILL_SYNC phase waits. Same original full-output oracle and finite input/three-expert coverage gates. Synchronization changes scheduling and cannot establish baseline bug repair or speed. No model speed/quality acceptance.
